capabilities: inject note tags as CSS classes on the view container
style tagged notes from CSS snippets
sanitize tag names into valid CSS classes
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Styling notes based on tags normally requires manually adding a cssclasses property to frontmatter on top of the tags you already use.
summary: Plugin that automatically adds a note's tags as CSS classes on the view container so tags can drive per-note styling.
